verdict.rationale: The product's own docs say users can customize, run, print, or export payroll reports. That is a first-party export capability, but it is limited to reports, and no export format is named. The developer API and SDK material counts only as building blocks, not as a data-portability feature. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, named open formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), coverage of employee records, documents and tax filings, offboarding/account-closure export guidance, and independent corroboration.
